body.answer: Illustrative example: I look at the housing first for grease leaking at the seal or discoloration. Leaking grease suggests the seal or bearing may be damaged, so I do not rotate the shaft until a supervisor has checked it.

fields.decision: Illustrative: do not rotate the shaft; escalate to a supervisor before continuing
